## What this manual covers

The Operations Manual describes **what BNR work must happen, who is responsible, where decisions occur and what evidence is retained**. It covers the whole registry pathway, from identifying a potential event to correcting or maintaining an approved public release.

The manual is public by design. It explains BNR procedures and controls without publishing patient information.

## The three BNR manuals

| Manual | Main purpose |
|---|---|
| **Operations Manual** | Govern the complete registry process and record operational decisions. |
| **[Technical Manual](../technical/index.qmd)** | Operate and maintain the post-REDCap analytics and publishing tools. |
| **[Public Methods Manual](../methods/index.qmd)** | Explain what BNR statistics mean and how they should be interpreted. |

The operations manual guides staff through the routine tasks needed to keep the BNR system running. The methods manual explains what the BNR measures and how its statistics should be understood. The technical manual documents the code, data processes and system design that support the BNR’s work.
